format: HTML with embedded JavaScript and CSS
description: This file is a template HTML file containing embedded JavaScript functions and minimal CSS styling intended for rendering and managing a wizard-style progress UI in a Campaigns module of a CRM system. It includes functions for centering menu items, updating step indicators, resetting widths, and navigation logic for workflow steps.

methods.name: wizardMenuCenter
methods.description: Centers the wizard menu by adjusting its left margin based on parent width.

methods.name: wizardMenuSetToCurrentStep
methods.description: Highlights and fills the wizard menu to indicate the current step based on DOM elements.

methods.name: wizardMenuCleanupAlreadyFinishedStep
methods.description: Reformats already finished steps' list items to include links if missing.

methods.name: wizardMenuCleanup
methods.description: Removes empty link elements and performs cleanup of the wizard menu.

methods.name: wizardMenuResetWidth
methods.description: Calculates total width of menu items and toggles a class for small width adjustments.

methods.name: wizardMenuFillAll
methods.description: Ensures all list items have a link, adding empty ones if missing.

methods.name: wizardMenuSetStepLink
methods.description: Sets or updates the hyperlink and onclick behavior for a specific step but is commented out.

methods.name: wizardMenuGetCurrentPage
methods.description: Determines the current wizard page by checking DOM visibility and campaign type.

methods.name: getBGImageName
methods.description: Extracts image filename from an element's background-image CSS property.

methods.name: wizardMenuPutDotToCurrentPage
methods.description: Highlights the current page dot in the visual progress indicator.

methods.name: wizardMenu
methods.description: Initializes and updates the wizard menu UI components.

methods.name: saveWizardState
methods.description: Placeholder function for saving wizard state.

methods.name: gotoWizardStep
methods.description: Navigates to a specified wizard step with validation and URL handling.
